Full suite 18 vs 18 identical failures, +3 passes; mutation drills red per site.
implications: Shipped NM-BUTTON-READY-PATTERN-1 at v5.108.7; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.108.7.md (Live criteria).
